source_intake.temporal_skew_assessment: No catastrophic calendar interval hole; every month contains thousands of unique arXiv records. Dense cs.LG/cs.CV slice capping and mutable publisher archives are the material completeness risks.

important_identity_and_lifecycle_decisio: InstructGPT, Chinchilla, PaLM, OPT, Flamingo, AlphaCode, VPT, Whisper and reward-model overoptimization pair paper and first-party observations into family/story Evidence while preserving source-specific chronology.
DALL-E 2 groups research paper/announcement, beta, waitlist removal and API public-beta observations into one lifecycle Evidence task; those states remain separate reader-facing chronology events.
Stable Diffusion groups the 2022 researcher-release and public-release observations into one model-family Evidence task while retaining the two availability boundaries independently.
BLOOM groups the July launch/access event with the later primary paper; release chronology is not replaced by paper-publication chronology.
OPT/BLOOM/GLM-130B are treated as model-access/open-weight evidence without equating weight access with open-source or open-training.
ChatGPT is treated as a November 2022 research-preview/product-interface boundary, not as proof that the later mature ChatGPT platform already existed in 2022.

chronology_conflicts.assessment: No unresolved contradiction blocks Architecture. Several sources expose different dates because announcement, paper publication, beta/GA/API/open-weight availability are distinct lifecycle states; these are preserved rather than forced into one date.

annual_phase_candidates.interpretation: Instruction following, explicit reasoning methods, dialogue modeling and compute-optimal scaling turn model behavior and training allocation into independent design questions.
Frontier scale, multimodal/image generation, model access, attention-system efficiency and deployed coding assistance become parallel technical layers around the foundation model.
Open model/data distribution and diffusion-based media generation accelerate; personalization, video/audio/3D research, speech interfaces and dialogue safety broaden the ecosystem.
Reasoning connects to action/retrieval, evaluation becomes more systematic, and late-year dialogue/product/control work culminates in ChatGPT, Constitutional AI and synthetic-instruction methods.

annual_trajectories: steering and reasoning: post-training, instruction tuning, prompting and synthetic instructions become separate ways to shape model behavior
scale, access and systems: compute/data allocation, model distribution and memory/IO efficiency qualify raw parameter-scale competition
multimodal and generative media: visual-language and image generation expand into an open data/model ecosystem and into video/audio/3D
code, action and retrieval: model outputs connect to developer workflows, environments and external knowledge rather than remaining text-only artifacts
dialogue interface and control: speech/dialogue products expose the need for alignment, rule-based control and reward-objective scrutiny
evaluation layer: broad and holistic evaluation becomes infrastructure for comparing increasingly heterogeneous systems
cross_period_comparison_candidates: early-year model behavior work versus late-year product/interface integration
closed/research-only model access versus summer open-weight/open-data distribution
image-generation research systems versus public local/open-weight diffusion ecosystems
generation-as-output versus generation feeding code, action and retrieval interfaces
capability benchmark expansion versus late-year holistic evaluation and control requirements
annual_reclassification_candidates: Treat instruction following/reasoning as a steering layer distinct from pretraining scale.
Treat model access, data access and runtime efficiency as separate systems/distribution constraints rather than model-quality properties.
Treat generative media as an ecosystem of models, data, personalization and release surfaces rather than an image-model leaderboard.
Treat code generation, retrieval and environment action as an emerging action/interface layer.
Treat evaluation and alignment/control as operating layers required by increasingly capable deployed systems.
cross_layer_synthesis_candidates: InstructGPT-style post-training and dialogue interfaces connect model behavior design directly to user-facing product behavior.
Chinchilla-style compute allocation and FlashAttention-style systems efficiency show that capability scaling is constrained by training and memory/IO systems, not only architecture size.
Stable Diffusion plus LAION/personalization evidence shows how model release, open data and local execution can change the innovation surface independently of frontier-model scale.
Copilot/ReAct/Atlas connect model reasoning to external execution or knowledge, increasing both utility and control requirements.
ChatGPT/Sparrow/Constitutional AI/HELM show productization, evaluation and control becoming coupled rather than separable postscript concerns.
editorial_thesis: 2022年、生成AIは単純なモデル規模の競争から、指示追従・推論を引き出すsteering/post-training、計算量とアクセスを制約として扱うscale/systems、画像から動画・音声・3Dへ広がる生成メディアとopen distribution、コード・検索・環境へ接続するaction interface、そして評価・alignment/controlを伴う対話製品という多層のシステムへ移行した。ChatGPTはこの転換の突然の起点ではなく、年内に積み上がった設計レイヤが対話UI上で統合された年末の境界として位置付ける。

architecture.approximate_reader_facing_chronology_eve: 45-55 provisional material events; exact count is deferred to chronology assembly after Architecture approval

residual_claim_boundaries: Vendor, project and author performance/capability evaluations remain attributed rather than treated as independently reproduced results.
Research paper publication, first-party announcement, preview/beta/GA/API/open-weight availability remain distinct chronology states.
Open weights/access are not treated as equivalent to open-source or open-training.
Current publisher indexes and capped arXiv slices cannot establish historical absence.
The configured GitHub release watchlist does not provide exhaustive commit-level 2022 runtime history.
Later 2023+ product maturity and ecosystem outcomes are not back-projected into the 2022 coverage window.

single_volume_coherence.assessment: The six proposed trajectories interact strongly across model behavior, compute/access constraints, media distribution, action interfaces, dialogue/control and evaluation. The annual thesis is stronger than a mechanical H1/H2 split, and the 68-page proposal remains well inside the configured 144-page maximum.
